<!-- Interactive Figure 2: square-root trajectories (purity scheme). Static SVG inlined verbatim; the script ADDS the user trajectory (grey arrows reuse the static arrowG marker; rho0 is a square coloured by its purity). JS off => static figure. -->
<style>
.trajectory-interactive{max-width:520px;margin:1.25rem auto;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;}
.trajectory-interactive svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;cursor:crosshair;}
.trajectory-interactive .tr-readout{margin-top:1rem;padding:0.9rem 1.1rem;background:#f4f6f8;border:1px solid #e2e8ee;border-radius:10px;}
.trajectory-interactive .tr-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px;}
.trajectory-interactive .tr-head-label{font-size:13px;color:#3a5a72;}
.trajectory-interactive .tr-hint{font-size:13px;color:#9aa9b5;}
.trajectory-interactive .tr-hint.is-set{color:#1f7a50;}
.trajectory-interactive .tr-rows{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;}
.trajectory-interactive .tr-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:62px 1fr;align-items:baseline;gap:12px;}
.trajectory-interactive .tr-key{font-family:ui-monospace,"SF Mono",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;font-size:13px;color:#3a5a72;}
.trajectory-interactive .tr-vec{font-family:ui-monospace,"SF Mono",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;font-size:14px;color:#9aa9b5;}
.trajectory-interactive .tr-vec.is-set{color:#1a3550;}
.trajectory-interactive .tr-vh{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);border:0;}
</style>

<div class="trajectory-interactive">
  <p class="tr-vh">Interactive square-root trajectories on the probability simplex, coloured by purity. Three default trajectories are shown: e1, e2, e3 each reach the maximally mixed centre in two steps, with e1 and e2 merging. Click inside the triangle to trace your own starting distribution and read off its two images under S.</p>

  <circle cx="140.0" cy="510.0" r="6.0" fill="#1f7a50"/>
  <circle cx="540.0" cy="430.0" r="6.0" fill="#1f7a50"/>
  <circle cx="310.0" cy="130.0" r="6.0" fill="#1f7a50"/>

  <circle cx="330.0" cy="356.7" r="7.5" fill="#f7faf8" fill-opacity="0.55" stroke="#5f7d70" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Vertex labels (green) + vectors (muted) -->
  <text x="132.0" y="536.0" text-anchor="end" font-size="21" font-style="italic" fill="#1f7a50">e₁</text>
  <text x="132.0" y="554.0" text-anchor="end" font-size="13" fill="#3a5a72">(1, 0, 0)</text>
  <text x="556.0" y="438.0" text-anchor="start" font-size="21" font-style="italic" fill="#1f7a50">e₂</text>
  <text x="556.0" y="456.0" text-anchor="start" font-size="13" fill="#3a5a72">(0, 1, 0)</text>
  <text x="310.0" y="102.0" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" font-style="italic" fill="#1f7a50">e₃</text>
  <text x="310.0" y="120.0" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="#3a5a72">(0, 0, 1)</text>

  <!-- Intermediate labels (muted) -->
  <text x="261.3" y="357.0" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" font-style="italic" fill="#3a5a72">q<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="0.72em" font-style="italic">a</tspan></text>
  <text x="475.3" y="335.0" text-anchor="start" font-size="15" font-style="italic" fill="#3a5a72">q<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="0.72em" font-style="italic">b</tspan></text>

  <!-- p0 label (de-emphasised) -->
  <text x="343.0" y="352.7" text-anchor="start" font-size="21" font-style="italic" fill="#5f7d70">p₀</text>

  <div class="tr-readout">
    <div class="tr-head">
      <span class="tr-head-label">Your trajectory under S</span>
      <span class="tr-hint" data-tr="hint">click inside the triangle</span>

    <div class="tr-rows">
      <div class="tr-row"><span class="tr-key">&rho;&#8320;</span><span class="tr-vec" data-tr="v0">&#8212;</span></div>
      <div class="tr-row"><span class="tr-key">S&#8202;&rho;&#8320;</span><span class="tr-vec" data-tr="v1">&#8212;</span></div>
      <div class="tr-row"><span class="tr-key">S&sup2;&#8202;&rho;&#8320;</span><span class="tr-vec" data-tr="v2">&#8212;</span></div>
    </div>

</div>

<script>
(function () {
  function setup(root) {
    var svg = root.querySelector('svg');
    if (!svg) return;
    var outline = null, polys = svg.querySelectorAll('polygon');
    for (var i = 0; i < polys.length; i++) { if (polys[i].getAttribute('fill') === 'none') { outline = polys[i]; break; } }
    if (!outline) return;
    var pts = outline.getAttribute('points').trim().split(/\s+/).map(function (p) {
      var c = p.split(','); return { x: parseFloat(c[0]), y: parseFloat(c[1]) };
    });
    if (pts.length < 3) return;
    var V1 = pts[0], V2 = pts[1], V3 = pts[2];   // e1, e2, e3

    var det = (V2.y - V3.y) * (V1.x - V3.x) + (V3.x - V2.x) * (V1.y - V3.y);
    function bary(px, py) {
      var b1 = ((V2.y - V3.y) * (px - V3.x) + (V3.x - V2.x) * (py - V3.y)) / det;
      var b2 = ((V3.y - V1.y) * (px - V3.x) + (V1.x - V3.x) * (py - V3.y)) / det;
      return [b1, b2, 1 - b1 - b2];
    }
    function toCanvas(p) { return [p[0]*V1.x + p[1]*V2.x + p[2]*V3.x, p[0]*V1.y + p[1]*V2.y + p[2]*V3.y]; }
    var S = [[1/2, 1/2, 0], [1/6, 1/6, 2/3], [1/3, 1/3, 1/3]];   // S^2 = P
    function applyS(p) {
      return [S[0][0]*p[0]+S[0][1]*p[1]+S[0][2]*p[2], S[1][0]*p[0]+S[1][1]*p[1]+S[1][2]*p[2], S[2][0]*p[0]+S[2][1]*p[1]+S[2][2]*p[2]];
    }
    function toSvg(evt) { var pt = svg.createSVGPoint(); pt.x = evt.clientX; pt.y = evt.clientY; var m = svg.getScreenCTM(); if (!m) return null; var l = pt.matrixTransform(m.inverse()); return [l.x, l.y]; }
    function lerp(a, b, t) { return Math.round(a + t * (b - a)); }
    function purityColour(p) {
      var s = p[0]*p[0] + p[1]*p[1] + p[2]*p[2];
      var t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (s - 1/3) / (2/3)));
      var A = [228,238,233], G = [31,122,80];
      return 'rgb(' + lerp(A[0],G[0],t) + ',' + lerp(A[1],G[1],t) + ',' + lerp(A[2],G[2],t) + ')';
    }

    var NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
    function el(t, a) { var e = document.createElementNS(NS, t); for (var k in a) e.setAttribute(k, a[k]); return e; }
    // reuse the static SVG's grey arrowhead (id arrowG)
    var hover = el('circle', { r: 5, fill: '#1f7a50', 'fill-opacity': '0.35', 'pointer-events': 'none', opacity: '0' });
    svg.appendChild(hover);
    var layer = el('g', { 'pointer-events': 'none' });
    svg.appendChild(layer);

    function shorten(a, b, ts, te) { var dx = b[0]-a[0], dy = b[1]-a[1], L = Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy); if (L < ts+te+1e-6) return [a,b]; var ux = dx/L, uy = dy/L; return [[a[0]+ts*ux, a[1]+ts*uy], [b[0]-te*ux, b[1]-te*uy]]; }
    function arrow(a, b) { var s = shorten(a, b, 11, 12); return el('line', { x1: s[0][0], y1: s[0][1], x2: s[1][0], y2: s[1][1], stroke: '#8a98a5', 'stroke-width': '2', 'stroke-linecap': 'round', 'marker-end': 'url(#arrowG)' }); }

    var hint = root.querySelector('[data-tr="hint"]');
    var vEls = [root.querySelector('[data-tr="v0"]'), root.querySelector('[data-tr="v1"]'), root.querySelector('[data-tr="v2"]')];
    function fmt(p) { function f(x){ var n = Math.round(x*100)/100; if (n === 0) n = 0; return n.toFixed(2); } return '(' + f(p[0]) + ', ' + f(p[1]) + ', ' + f(p[2]) + ')'; }
    function clearLayer() { while (layer.firstChild) layer.removeChild(layer.firstChild); }
    function reset() { clearLayer(); hint.textContent = 'click inside the triangle'; hint.classList.remove('is-set'); for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) { vEls[i].textContent = '—'; vEls[i].classList.remove('is-set'); } }
    function show(b, c0) {
      clearLayer();
      var s1 = applyS(b), s2 = applyS(s1);
      var c1 = toCanvas(s1), c2 = toCanvas(s2);
      layer.appendChild(arrow(c0, c1));
      layer.appendChild(arrow(c1, c2));
      layer.appendChild(el('circle', { cx: c1[0], cy: c1[1], r: 5.5, fill: purityColour(s1), stroke: '#0f5538', 'stroke-width': '1.3' }));
      layer.appendChild(el('circle', { cx: c2[0], cy: c2[1], r: 5, fill: purityColour(s2), stroke: '#0f5538', 'stroke-width': '1.3' }));
      var sq = 9;   // rho0: a user-placed square (shape, not colour, marks "yours")
      layer.appendChild(el('rect', { x: c0[0]-sq/2, y: c0[1]-sq/2, width: sq, height: sq, fill: purityColour(b), stroke: '#0f5538', 'stroke-width': '1.5' }));
      var vals = [b, s1, s2];
      for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) { vEls[i].textContent = fmt(vals[i]); vEls[i].classList.add('is-set'); }
      hint.textContent = 'two steps to p₀'; hint.classList.add('is-set');
    }

    var EPS = -1e-6;
    function inside(b) { return b[0] >= EPS && b[1] >= EPS && b[2] >= EPS; }
    svg.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) { if (e.pointerType && e.pointerType !== 'mouse') return; var loc = toSvg(e); if (!loc) return; var b = bary(loc[0], loc[1]); if (inside(b)) { hover.setAttribute('cx', loc[0]); hover.setAttribute('cy', loc[1]); hover.setAttribute('opacity', '1'); } else hover.setAttribute('opacity', '0'); });
    svg.addEventListener('pointerleave', function () { hover.setAttribute('opacity', '0'); });
    svg.addEventListener('click', function (e) { var loc = toSvg(e); if (!loc) return; var b = bary(loc[0], loc[1]); if (inside(b)) show(b, loc); else reset(); });
  }
  function init() { var roots = document.querySelectorAll('.trajectory-interactive'); for (var i = 0; i < roots.length; i++) setup(roots[i]); }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  else init();
})();
</script>
